tei:div.tei:p:
With great love hast Thou loved us, O Lord our God, great and abundant compassion hast Thou shown us. Our Father, our King, for the sake of our fathers who trusted in
Thee and whom Thou didst teach the statutes of life, likewise be gracious to us and teach us. Our Father, merciful and compassionate Father, have compassion upon us and set it in our heart to comprehend and to understand, to hear, to learn and to teach, to keep, perform and fulfil all words of the teaching of Thy Torah in love. Enlighten our eyes through Thy Torah, attach our heart to Thy commandments, consecrate our heart to love Thy Name and to fear it, so that never may we be disgraced. For in Thy great and awe-inspiring Name do we trust, we exult and rejoice in Thy help. Bring us in peace from the four corners of the earth and lead us upright into our land. For Thou art God who creates salvation and Thou hast chosen us from all peoples and tongues and brought us near Thy great Name for ever in truth, to thank Thee and to proclaim Thy unity. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who has chosen His people Israel in love.
